source: The Japanese font families R19 recognised in render/check_render.py, moved here so that validate_tokens.py (T22) and check_render.py (R19) read one list. Each entry is a lower-case substring matched against a lower-cased family name; a trailing space marks a word boundary ('zen '). Entries are already lower-case, so the full-width ＭＳ of ＭＳ ゴシック is written ｍｓ.
